overall: All three observed v0.2 responses satisfy the frozen output contract and exhibit appropriate diffusion reasoning in this single three-case comparison. No material stage/posture/application-transfer flaw identified. Narrow temporal-provenance and sampling-wording weaknesses merit a targeted instruction control, not rejection of the substantive findings.
general_invariance: All three use the same individual technical-worker evidence, preserve broad-AI/LLM and person/firm distinctions, and leave exact global/peer Rogers stage unresolved. Primary and Hospital cautiously allow diffusion beyond isolated innovators in the sampled setting; Startup does not claim a different global stage.

five_factor_review.primary: All five explicit. Net relative advantage uncertain after quality/rework; editor compatibility conditional; version/training/review complexity; reversible permissioned trialability; observability through credible quality-adjusted outcomes rather than demos.
five_factor_review.contrast_1: All five explicit, with observations/directions/mechanisms/conditions/confidence. Flexible workflows support learning options, but limited staff and review/security burden constrain broad reliance.
five_factor_review.contrast_2: All five explicit with no direct clinical evidence; quality-adjusted note time/rework unknown; EHR/privacy fit and verification burden constrain progression; medical-model access is not clinical trial authorization or diffusion.

context_change.primary: Fast Follower: baseline/peer audit and permissioned reviewed pilot; proposed 6–8-week review before standardization discussion, contingent on quality, security and sustained use.
context_change.contrast_1: Early Adopter startup: isolated low-consequence task-level learning; short iterative review cycles and scarce review capacity, rather than assuming mature company deployment or changing general technology stage.
context_change.contrast_2: Hospital: documentation-only definition and baseline/peer evidence first; conditional privacy/EHR/clinical authority and safety gates before considering evaluation. No transfer from coding rates or MedGemma availability.

unsupported_claims: All three preserve abstention on current exact LLM/industry stage, firm-wide sustained deployment and most-hospital routine-documentation claims; exact adoption forecasts, causal productivity and ROI magnitudes remain unsupported.
authority_boundary: Recommendations are conditional timing/learning advice, proposed review events and gates; responsible management/clinical/security owners and Adoption Agent retain deployment/adoption authority.

stable_quote.primary_quote: For global LLM users, software organizations and hospitals, the exact Rogers stage, saturation and diffusion forecast are unresolved.
stable_quote.startup_quote: The startup’s posture alters acceptable experimentation timing, not the E1–E4 general adoption statistics or the technology’s population Rogers stage.
stable_quote.hospital_quote: Substantial surveyed technical-worker use is compatible with adoption beyond isolated innovators in that sampled setting, but biased cross-sectional broad-AI data do not assign a defensible exact category, percentage split, chasm crossing, S-curve, saturation, global LLM stage or current hospital stage.

changed_quotes.primary_quote: At a proposed 6-8-week pilot review event within the assumed six-month horizon, compare results and obtain dated peer evidence before any broader standardization discussion.
changed_quotes.startup_quote: Agree a reassessment event/date at pilot setup (for example, after two review cycles), not a claimed evidence-backed deadline.
changed_quotes.hospital_quote: Only if authorized privacy/data/EHR and clinician-review gates are met should management consider a small reversible evaluation on approved workflows with predefined patient-safety, note-quality, time and stop criteria; any schedule or threshold is a management proposal, not a measured benchmark.

limitations: One user-supplied run per case, not repeated reliability evidence.
Runtime model/settings, exact execution timestamps and chat references not supplied; no inference from output text.
Shared single-issuer empirical dossier with E2/E4 data dependence and old observations; full E1 2025 sampling methods unavailable.
No clinical-documentation industry penetration, local quality/safety evidence, enterprise sustained-retention or LLM-only representative prevalence.
All three recommendations share justified governance themes; contrasts demonstrate conditional reasoning, not measured superiority or an empirically established faster startup timeline.

weaknesses.kind: Unsupported temporal provenance, minor but traceability-relevant

quotes.quote: a six-month planning horizon from the 2026-11-01 test date

weaknesses.diagnosis: The packet/snapshot preparation date is supplied; an actual execution timestamp is not. These strings promote a preparation/as-of date into a test-date fact. The available record does not establish that date as false; it establishes it is unsupported. This is distinct from the valid six-month duration and not the earlier 12-versus-6 proposal discrepancy.
weaknesses.impact: Can misstate test provenance and anchor a calendar horizon without evidence. Does not overturn general stage interpretation or relative timing logic.
weaknesses.control: State actual run date unknown unless supplied; distinguish snapshot, publication, observation, retrieval and execution dates; retain relative six-month planning duration when anchor unknown.

weaknesses.kind: Overcategorical sampling wording, minor precision weakness

quotes.quote: nonrepresentative sampling preclude an exact category

weaknesses.diagnosis: These aggregate formulations can read as a determined design/representativeness classification for E1 2025, whose recruitment/probability design was not inspected. Other passages correctly state that E1 methods are unavailable. E4 has inspected organic-plus-panel recruitment, so cautious discussion of its selection limits is justified.
weaknesses.impact: Unnecessary certainty about missing source metadata; the conclusion that population generalization is unestablished remains defensible.
weaknesses.control: Keep unverified E1 sampling design unknown; say representativeness not established. Scope known E4 recruitment limits to E4 rather than all surveys.

revision_decision: A narrow v0.3 instruction control is justified for provenance precision, with unchanged evidence and six-month cases. Prepare Primary and Hospital retest packets; Startup retest is optional because these specific defects were not found there. No three-case rerun is required solely for the six-month horizon.

retest_status.contrast_1_v0.3: NOT REQUIRED for these observed narrow weaknesses; optional further regression coverage
